annotations.title: Import a website into a project

description: Starts crawling one of your organization's VERIFIED websites into a Search project. mode 'preview' reports what an import would contain and changes nothing; mode 'import' REPLACES the project's catalogue with what is found. Takes minutes; check progress with search_import_status. Only one import runs at a time. The person confirms before it starts. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

site.description: Which verified website, e.g. example.com. Needed only when the organization has more than one.

name: search_start_import
